reviews.title: 1st ever review--genuinely helpful
reviews.text: I have tried more journal and mood tracking apps than I would ever admit. They all fall short in some way--either too directive and workbook-like--or too open-ended or too cookie cutter--but Clearful hasn't been like that. The daily prompts and reflection prompts are able to get past my cynical self and into really journaling and reflecting on my life.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: This has by far been my favorite journaling app because I can combine all my different journals into one app instead of having one for my Morning/Evening pages, one for my gratitude journaling, and one for my weekly reviews. I have one suggestion, though. I would love to see the ability to set more than one notification, as someone with ADHD. Right now, I have to choose which journal I’m most forgetful about and set that reminder and hope for the best with my other journaling times throughout the day/week.

reviews.title: Lost 4+ Years of Journals
reviews.text: I am soo ticked right now, I have been using this app for over 4 years, never really had to log in - like ever, even when switching over phones! Now with some new update I can’t get back into my account, I have tried a variety of emails/logins but can’t seem to get back to wherever I had originally logged in to! I love looking back and seeing trends and how I have grown….but I guess not anymore. Would’ve been nice to have a heads up or make it more obvious the login if one day it forced me out!

reviews.title: A real treasure of an app that brings me peace every day
reviews.text: I absolutely love Clearful. As a developer myself I can tell they put a lot of time and care into creating a simple yet well thought out experience. I love the variety of prompts and templates to choose from. I can write for a few seconds or much longer depending on how I’m feeling that day. The features of the app are great- easy to use, useful, but not overwhelming or distracting. The fact that they offer quite a bit of free content is a breath of fresh air compared to the state of many other in-app purchases today. I will definitely consider trying the paid version as I continue to go through the free prompts. Thank you, Clearful for putting together an app that has helped me a lot through the last couple of tough months in life.

reviews.title: Clear and Concise
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a good journaling app, at least until Apple brings their app to Mac. And Clearful seems to be just perfect for my wishes. The app itself is very clear, as you might expect with that name. I’m able to get in and do my journaling without a lot of fuss. It’s simple to use, and I appreciate the privacy options greatly. I have no complaints so far, it meets all my needs and I recommend giving it a try. I appreciate all the templates and different kinds of entries I can make as well. When the trial was over, I was all too happy to become an annual subscriber.

reviews.title: 7 Day Trial? Not true!
reviews.text: Down loaded Clearful on my desktop. While creating an account it offered a 7-day trial for PRO. So I decided to try it, though I knew I would probably cancel it before the 7 days because $89.99 is a hefty price tag. I even took screenshots of the offer to confirm that I would not be charged till 7 days later unless I canceled first. Turns out they charged me immediately and there was no 7 day trial. Still waiting to here back from Apple if they will refund this error/scam charge? I assume this isn't intential by the developer, but seems like a big flaw that needs to be fixed.

reviews.text:
I have tried a few journaling apps and Clearful has been my favorite so far. It’s so simple and easy to use. Other apps don’t feel as intuitive to use. I love the prompts, and different options to help me provide a structure if I need it so that I feel motivated to journal each day. Sometimes it’s hard to process through things so the prompts really help ask me the right questions and give me a starting point to begin my entry for the day. Other days I love to just open a blank journal entry and free write my thoughts. 
Amazing app, I would highly recommend
